5mls:
Program Description

Develop a deep understanding of financial markets, financial institutions, and the financial decision-making processes. Manage the risks, returns, and value of traditional and alternative assets and investments. Finance is not accounting. Finance is about analyzing and managing the risks and returns of investments and assets—both within corporate settings and in trading and banking—to ensure the long-term success of the organization.

Through the completion of this program, students will gain valuable professional skills such as: accounting, asset evaluation, risk management, financial marketing, portfolio management, and more.

Program Description

Students can prepare to thrive in a rapidly changing business world with Hult’s one-year MIB. They gain all-round business experience in an international environment and develop the skills most in-demand with employers worldwide.

Students become a valuable contributor to any organization as they learn innovative business skills as well as meaningful communication and collaboration. Students develop key skills such as business process and analysis, international marketing, data visualization and storytelling, and financial literacy. They can explore opportunities to launch new products in global markets and determine a market strategy for success through real-world business challenges that are integrated into your entire program.
5m68:
Management is fundamental to everything—whether managing teams, processes, or the organization. It's easy to be a manager. It’s very difficult to be a good manager. Management is not just about staff—it’s about the smooth running of systems, processes & operations, and one's self.

Through the completion of this program, students will gain valuable professional skills such as: leadership, change management, organizational skills, project management, quality control management, and more.
5mi0:
Students can harness the power of big data through statistical analysis and business acumen with Hult International Business School's one-year MBAN and go on to make a meaningful impact in any organization.

Students will develop the skills to become a data-driven business leader in a complex global environment. Students will dive into the world of data analysis, forecasting, prescription, and optimization while they work in parallel to hone their collaboration and communication skills as well as gaining critical business knowledge to maximize their impact. Students work in cross-cultural teams and gain a global perspective as they tackle real-world business challenges that are integrated into their entire program.
5mi2:
Students will stand out in a competitive global marketplace with Hult International Business School's one-year Masters in International Marketing (MIM) that equips them with the international strategic skills, creative executional ability, and cutting-edge knowledge to thrive in a constantly shifting digital environment.

Students will understand the importance of the customer journey in today's fragmented media landscape. They will learn to develop a marketing strategy leveraging tools needed to market through digital channels, conduct market research with an eye toward new product development, and examine global market opportunities for expansion and growth. Students will gain a solid foundation of marketing analytic skills and learn to develop key metrics for a successful strategy as they take part in real-world business challenges that are integrated into their entire program.
5me1:
Students want an Master of Business Administration that will give them a competitive edge in the rapidly changing global economy and future-proof their career. Hult International Business School's Master of Business Administration programs have been designed to develop the skills most in demand with employers worldwide so students can make an impact from their first day on the job.

Students can accelerate their career in international business in one intensive year with a transformative campus experience that immerses them in diversity and takes them across the globe. Students learn business by doing it and specialize in their chosen area so they graduate with the practical skills, applicable knowledge, and effective mindsets to transform their life and career.

Students take courses such as: leadership journey, managing relationships, personal influence, moral perspective, building a sales strategy, and more.
